label: prf:colour-singlet-flavour-generator
title: Proof of the colour-singlet flavour generator
html: For item 1, direct matrix computation on (K^3)^{\otimes 3} verifies that Jimbo's \check R satisfies the quadratic Hecke relation, the braid relation \check R_{12}\check R_{23}\check R_{12} = \check R_{23}\check R_{12}\check R_{23}, and commutes with the three-fold coproducts of E_i, F_i, and L_j. For item 2, solving E_i v = F_i v = 0 and L_j v = v in (K^3)^{\otimes 3} under q \neq 0 and q^2 + 1 \neq 0 shows that the U_q(\mathfrak{gl}_3)-invariant subspace is one-dimensional and spanned by the q-antisymmetric vector \varepsilon_q, on which \check R_{12} and \check R_{23} each act by the scalar -q^{-1}. Item 3 follows immediately on K\varepsilon_q \otimes W: since \check R_{\mathrm{colour}} acts as -q^{-1}, the tensor braiding X = \check R_{\mathrm{colour}} \cdot b restricts to -q^{-1} b, and multiplying by -q recovers b. For item 4, scaling every generator by a central scalar c multiplies the evaluation of a braid word w of exponent sum e(w) by c^{e(w)}, and linearity of \tau pulls c^{e(w)} out of \tau(w); setting c = -q^{-1} gives the raw-generator factor, and setting c = 1 for -qX gives exact agreement with the flavour trace.
